dishes.name: Idli (2 pcs) with Sambar & Coconut Chutney
dishes.notes: Fermented rice-dal batter. Moderate GI; sambar dal lowers peak slope slightly.

dishes.name: Masala Dosa with Potato Masala & Chutney
dishes.serving: 1 large crisp dosa with 80g potato filling + chutney
dishes.notes: High glycemic index due to refined parboiled rice and mashed potato filling.

dishes.name: Ven Pongal with Ghee & Pepper
dishes.notes: Rice-moong dal mash with ghee. High starch availability causes sustained peak.

dishes.name: Ragi Mudde with Bassaru / Sambar
dishes.serving: 1 ragi ball (200g) + 120ml leafy greens lentil curry
dishes.notes: Finger millet staple with high dietary fiber and polyphenol content, attenuating glucose rise.

dishes.name: Dal Tadka with Steamed Basmati Rice
dishes.serving: 150g cooked white basmati rice + 150ml yellow toor dal
dishes.notes: Most common daily lunch across urban India. Substantial glycemic load if rice exceeds 1 cup.

dishes.name: 2 Phulka Rotis (Whole Wheat) with Bhindi Sabzi & Dal
dishes.notes: Optimal everyday meal. Whole wheat fiber + okra mucilage slows gastric emptying.

dishes.name: Paneer Butter Masala with 1 Garlic Naan
dishes.notes: Refined flour (maida) combined with high saturated fat causes a biphasic, late-delayed glucose spike (Pizza effect).

dishes.name: Chicken / Vegetable Dum Biryani with Raita
dishes.serving: 280g spiced basmati rice & chicken/veggies + 80g curd raita
dishes.notes: Popular weekend feast; raita curd provides lactic acid slightly buffering digestion.

dishes.name: Besan Chilla (2 pcs) with Mint & Coriander Chutney
dishes.serving: 2 gram-flour crepes (150g) with onions, tomatoes + chutney
dishes.notes: Gram flour (chana dal flour) has low GI and high protein, ideal for morning postprandial stability.

dishes.name: Poha with Peanuts, Curry Leaves & Peas
dishes.notes: Flattened parboiled rice; quick enzymatic hydrolysis produces sharp 45-min peak.

dishes.name: Vegetable Upma with Roasted Semolina
dishes.notes: Semolina (rava) base. Rapid starch absorption without added fiber or pulses.

dishes.name: Rajma Masala with Brown Rice & Cucumber Salad
dishes.serving: 150g brown rice + 150g kidney bean curry + 60g salad
dishes.notes: Outstanding resistant starch profile from kidney beans + brown rice fiber.

dishes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi with 1 tsp Ghee & Curd
dishes.notes: Split yellow moong dal provides accessible amino acids; gentle digestion profile.

dishes.name: Fish Curry (Mustard/Macher Jhol) with Steamed Rice
dishes.serving: 150g rice + 120g rohu fish in light cumin-turmeric broth
dishes.notes: High lean marine protein triggers early GLP-1 release, mitigating white rice spike.

dishes.name: Masala Chai (with 1.5 tsp sugar) + 3 Marie Biscuits
dishes.notes: Ubiquitous 4 PM corporate/household habit in India. Rapid sucrose spike with zero fiber barrier.

dishes.name: Roasted Makhana (Foxnuts) with Unsweetened Green Tea
dishes.serving: 35g dry-roasted makhana with pinch of rock salt + green tea
dishes.notes: Healthy replacement for evening biscuit habit. Low glycemic impact.

dishes.name: Chole Bhature (1 Bhatura + Chickpea Curry)
dishes.notes: Deep-fried maida creates persistent glycemic excursion lasting 4+ hours.

dishes.name: Sambar Sadam (Sambar Rice) with Appalam
dishes.notes: Convenience lunch. Moderate fiber from drumstick, pumpkin, toor dal.

dishes.name: Jowar Bhakri with Pithla (Gram Flour Curry) & Thecha
dishes.notes: Sorghum (jowar) is gluten-free with slow starch digestibility.

dishes.name: Aloo Paratha (1 pc) with Butter & Curd
dishes.notes: Mashed potato stuffing wrapped in whole wheat pan-fried in fat.

dishes.name: Appam (2 pcs) with Vegetable Stew
dishes.serving: 2 fermented rice-coconut appams (140g) + 150ml coconut milk stew
dishes.notes: Coconut milk medium-chain triglycerides slow peak absorption slightly.

dishes.name: Dhokla (Khaman - 4 pcs) with Green Chutney
dishes.serving: 4 steamed squares (140g) with mustard tempering + chutney
dishes.notes: Steamed gram flour snack. Often tempered with sugar syrup in commercial settings.

dishes.name: Egg Bhurji (2 eggs) with 2 Multigrain Toasts
dishes.serving: Scrambled eggs with onions, chilies (120g) + 2 slices toast (60g)
dishes.notes: High biological value protein suppresses early glycemic spike.

dishes.name: Samosa (1 pc) with Tamarind Chutney
dishes.notes: Deep fried maida shell + boiled potatoes + sweetened chutney. High postprandial glucose spike.

dishes.name: Sprouted Moong Salad (Sundal style with Lemon & Coconut)
dishes.serving: 1 bowl sprouted whole moong (150g) with cucumber, lemon, fresh coconut
dishes.notes: Superb clinical choice. Sprouting boosts bioavailable micronutrients and dietary fiber.

economics.sensors: Fitbit Sense + Static EHR Labs Only

excursion_label_definition.clinical_rationale: Identifies true new postprandial glycemic excursions above ADA postprandial euglycemic threshold without baseline leakage.

conformal_uncertainty.conformal_exchangeability_note: Split conformal marginal coverage on temporal series holds asymptotically across patient clusters, though localized rapid swings may exhibit conditional heteroscedasticity.
